def generate(rng):
    # Sparse rectangular canvas, containing one small 2-colored marker object
    h = rng.randint(5, 18); w = rng.randint(5, 18)
    g = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    # choose a 2x2 object, with one cell recolored 9 (the distinctive palette)
    r = rng.randint(0, h-2); c = rng.randint(0, w-2)
